hub: Layer 01 Govern-as-Code: the internal control set — the Policy Cards and Eval Gates the organisation maintains — each declaring the framework clauses it maps to, so the crosswalk is generated from the controls rather than kept beside them.
evidence: Layer 05 Assurance & Continuous Compliance: the evidence store attached to the hub, so a mapping cell resolves to a running control and its emitted evidence, and the same evidence is reused for every framework.
eu: The EU AI Act, one of the overlapping frameworks the control set maps to; a label on the crosswalk, not a claim of conformity.
iso: ISO/IEC 42001 and its Annex A control objectives, mapped to from the same internal controls.
nist: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework and its four functions, mapped to from the same internal controls.
csa: The CSA AI Controls Matrix (247 control objectives across 18 domains), one of the reference vocabularies the crosswalk anchors on.
owasp: The OWASP Agent Control Standard, an agent-specific vocabulary the crosswalk maps to.
